label: preparing
what: A private surprise marking my forty years as mayor, apparently involving a committee presentation at the town hall tomorrow around eighteen. The innkeeper previously requested an outside escort and concealed presentation, then withdrew the formal request as an anniversary surprise; the proposed walk returning to the plaza around eighteen plausibly serves that escort purpose. Other committee members are unidentified. The secretary knows of the plan and has preserved its record, though active involvement beyond administrative handling is uncertain.
